concept: An inventive sky-current laboratory shaped by flowing vessels, clean energy, and unexpected colour.
floor: One continuous smooth turquoise glazed-stone floor across the full top face, with broad cyan-to-violet shading and no water, grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One oversized abstract sky-vessel sculpture at the rear pouring two broad solid cyan ribbon forms into a low architectural channel that ends well above the open stage.
rear_props: one broad silver control plinth with no markings
side_props: two oversized turquoise coil sculptures on the upper-left edge
one chunky violet bench and one cyan vessel on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded turquoise wall with broad silver and violet cap blocks

lighting: soft bright sky light with restrained cyan illumination visible only on the island surfaces; the surrounding background remains perfectly black
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open glazed-stone floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, person, animal, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
open water, waterfall leaving the island, zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
background aura, cyan halo outside the silhouette, gradient background, bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, bubbles, electric specks, tiny controls, cracks, or dense clutter
